ledger.claim: The arrival radius for this STANDARD pickup is 50 m, and the driver's own device trace never once places him inside it: 0 of his 84 fixes qualify as in-radius and his closest approach across the entire trace is 377.4 m from the pin, against a 25 m accuracy filter. Under POL-NS-02, where the trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix at any point in the 15 minutes preceding the cancellation, the driver never arrived and POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails.

POL-NS-01 is conjunctive and the rider wins by breaking a single limb. Limb (b) fails because there is no in-radius fix; limb (c) fails because the required continuous in-geofence dwell is 300 seconds for this STANDARD zone and the measured dwell is 0.0 seconds, the trace recording no in-geofence run at all. The 'arrived' event is a driver button press recorded in the trip record, which is IMPAIRED at weight 0.4 with issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT: the record implies a 6.5 minute wait at the pin while the trace has every fix in that interval about 850 m away. The impaired record cannot carry the charge on its own.

The free-waiting minimum in force is 300 seconds and the effective in-geofence dwell, computed under POL-NS-02, is 0.0 seconds - a 300 second shortfall. POL-NS-06 is strict: the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she answered messages.

The shortfall cannot be cured by accumulation. POL-NS-06 limb (i) permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a traffic advisory covering the pickup road is present and populated, and the only advisory artifact for this trip, EV-ADVIS-00410-01, is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - no advisory covers Serangoon Ave 3 in this window. Limb (i) is therefore unavailable, and with 0 in-geofence intervals there is nothing to accumulate in any event.

POL-NS-04 exoneration holds on its first and third limbs. (a) The rider sent a locating message inside the waiting window - 'where are you? im at the block' at 09:12:00 - naming her block and asking for the driver's position. (c) Her track places her within the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius on all 44 of 44 qualifying fixes, at a mean of 14.6 m and a maximum of 19.1 m, with 0.0 kph the only speed in her track: she was stationary at the pin.

POL-NS-04 limb (b) also holds: the driver neither posted a reply in the chat within 120 seconds of the 09:12:00 message nor placed an in-app voice call. The chat log is COMPLETE and shows only the system 'Your driver has arrived' notice and the rider's message, and the trip record's in_app_calls list is empty; he cancelled 270 seconds after her message without answering. The trip record is IMPAIRED at weight 0.4 with issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, but this limb is carried by the clean chat log and the empty call list is not contradicted by any other artifact.

The arrival marker is false and the waiting clock must be recomputed. At the arrival timestamp the driver was more than 300 m from the pin - his closest approach at any point of the whole trace is 377.4 m - so POL-NS-05 is triggered on the distance limb. Recomputing the clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix yields none: there is no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere in the trip, so POL-NS-05 limb (ii) fixes the outcome - the cancellation fee is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and the false arrival is recorded against the driver as a referral.

The platform-confirmed-arrival route in POL-NS-12 is not open to the driver: that clause covers only an arrival_marker of GPS_AUTO, and this trip's platform_policy.arrival_marker is BUTTON, a driver-pressed marker, which POL-NS-12 expressly excludes. The arrival therefore remains subject to POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05. The trip record is IMPAIRED at weight 0.4 (issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT) but the arrival_marker field is a platform policy field that nothing in the trace contradicts.

Even on the driver's most favourable reading - that he was near but at the wrong face of the block - POL-NS-03 still refunds the rider in full, and it cannot fund him here. Limb (ii) pin-ambiguity goodwill requires registered_pickup_points of 2 or more, and this trip records exactly 1, so no platform-funded goodwill arises. The rider did state her location in the chat ('im at the block', the pickup point itself being a block address) and the driver did not move to it before cancelling, which limb (i) treats as the driver bearing the loss with no compensation.

ledger.claim: The direct conflict between the trip record and the trace does not force escalation. POL-NS-09(b) requires that no clause resolve the conflict, and POL-NS-05 resolves it by testing and falsifying the button-pressed arrival marker on the trace; and POL-NS-09(e) is not engaged because the deciding fact - the driver's position at and around the arrival time - is carried by EV-GPS-00410 at full weight 1.0, while the trip record's tag is a schema-level CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, not an impairment under any limb of POL-NS-08: the arrival event matches a fix to within 5 seconds, there are no trace gaps and no missing rider track, the chat log matches chat_message_count, and the $4.00 fare line reconciles with the figure in force. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the cap on confidence is the maximum weight among independent carriers of the deciding fact, which is 1.0.

The money follows the clauses. The ledger shows the $4.00 cancellation fee charged (payment_status CHARGED, total_charged 4.00) with nothing returned (refund_issued_sgd 0.00), and that $4.00 is the cancellation fee in force for this trip. POL-NS-06 and POL-NS-05(ii) refund the cancellation-fee line in full, and POL-GEN-03 gives the filing party the whole contested amount. The rider's claim is supported and the disposition is FULL_REFUND of $4.00 with no driver compensation.

The platform's own trip_record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-08-24T09:10:00+08:00 and terminates the trip at 09:16:30 by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises, so limbs (a) and (d) of the baseline chargeable no-show are satisfied on the record. The artifact is impaired and I disclose it as POL-GEN-02(1) requires: weight_multiplier 0.4, issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT; that tag goes to the recorded position, not to the existence of the arrival and termination events.

On the record's own clock the driver held the pickup for 390 seconds - arrived_at 09:10:00 to cancelled_at 09:16:30 - which exceeds the 300 second free waiting period in force for this STANDARD pickup (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 300), and the required dwell had elapsed at 09:15:00, so the driver's termination at 09:16:30 falls after it: POL-NS-01(c) is met on the record and nothing in POL-NS-05 needs to shorten the clock. Disclosed: EV-TRIP-00410 is impaired at weight 0.4 with issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT.

The arrival event is carried by a second artifact that is clean: the platform's own messaging layer sent the system message 'Your driver has arrived' to the rider at 09:10:01, delivered 09:10:02 and read by the rider at 09:10:20, per EV-CHAT-00410 (COMPLETE, weight 1.0). Because two independent artifacts carry the arrival fact - the trip record at 0.4 and the platform message log at 1.0 - POL-GEN-02(2) sets the confidence cap at the MAXIMUM of those weights, 1.0, and not at 0.4, so the arrival finding does not of itself drag the case below the 0.70 floor. Disclosed: EV-TRIP-00410 is impaired at 0.4 with issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, and the claim is put on the strength of the clean message log.

The amount charged is the amount in force and shows no integrity defect: fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee of SGD 4.00 equals trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.00, the ledger's own derived reconciliation difference is 0.00, and payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00. POL-NS-08(d) therefore does not fire, so there is no fare-integrity route to a refund, a split or an escalation on the amount.

If the tribunal resolves the arrival question on the platform's trip record, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the fee in force - SGD 3.20 of SGD 4.00, which is the figure the fare ledger itself derives (derived.money.driver_compensation = 3.20) - and the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring 3.20, not NO_ACTION, because POL-NS-07 and POL-GEN-03 both state that the disposition of the FEE ('the ruling on the fee is NO_ACTION') is not the ruling VALUE.

At the least, the two admissible artifacts that speak to the deciding fact contradict each other directly and the conflict is not resolved on this record: EV-TRIP-00410 has the driver arrived at the pin for the whole interval 09:10:00 to 09:16:30, while the admissibility pre-pass records EV-GPS-00410 as holding every fix in that same interval about 850 m from the pin at 5-11 m accuracy, and the trace's own derived summary reports 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes and a 0 second longest qualifying run. That is precisely the posture POL-NS-09(b) names ('trip_record records a 6 minute dwell while gps_trace places the driver 800 m from the pin throughout the same interval'), so the case belongs with a human reviewer, and under POL-GEN-03 escalation is terminal and holds the disputed SGD 4.00 rather than collecting or refunding it. Disclosed: EV-TRIP-00410 carries weight 0.4 with issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your claim is upheld in full — the $4.00 no-show cancellation fee charged on TRP-00410 is refunded and the driver receives no compensation. To the driver: the fee cannot stand, because your own device trace shows you never reached the pickup point and the arrival marker you pressed was false.

1. POL-NS-01 fails. The clause charges a no-show fee only if all four limbs hold. Limbs (a) and (d) do hold: EV-TRIP-00410 records an 'arrived' event at 2026-08-24T09:10:00+08:00 and a driver termination at 09:16:30 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the codes limb (d) recognises. Limbs (b) and (c) do not. EV-GPS-00410 (COMPLETE, weight 1.0, 84 fixes at 10 s cadence) records 0 of 84 driver fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius and a closest approach of 377.4 m, so limb (b) fails. The dwell, measured as limb (c) directs from GPS entry into the geofence, is 0.0 s against the 300 s free-waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 300; the 180 s default would change nothing), so limb (c) fails too. POL-NS-01 is conjunctive: two broken limbs are enough.

2. The arrival marker is false and POL-NS-05 governs. At the 09:10:00 marker the trace places the driver more than 300 m from the pin — the admissibility pre-pass records every fix from 09:10:00 to 09:16:30 at about 850 m, and the closest approach at any point of the trip is 377.4 m — so the button press did not start the waiting clock. Recomputing the clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix yields nothing, so POL-NS-05(ii) applies: full refund of the $4.00 cancellation fee, no driver compensation, and a false-arrival record against the driver in the referrals.

3. POL-NS-06 reaches the same result independently: effective dwell 0.0 s against a 300 s minimum is a 300 s shortfall, and limb (i)'s accumulation route is unavailable — the only advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-00410-01, is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT), and there are no in-geofence intervals to sum in any event.

4. POL-NS-04 also exonerates the rider: 'where are you? im at the block' was sent at 09:12:00 inside the waiting window (limb (a)); no chat reply came within 120 seconds and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, the driver cancelling 270 seconds later (limb (b)); and the rider track places her within the 100 m STANDARD presence radius on all 44 qualifying fixes, mean 14.6 m, maximum 19.1 m (limb (c)).

5. Arguments rejected. (i) The record's own 390-second clock (09:10:00 to 09:16:30) does not satisfy limb (c): POL-NS-01(c) expressly measures the dwell from GPS entry into the geofence, not from the arrival tap, and the trace never enters it. (ii) The system chat message 'Your driver has arrived' at 09:10:01 (EV-CHAT-00410, weight 1.0) is not a second, independent carrier of the arrival fact: it is generated from the same button press, and if the instrument evidence were removed it would support nothing, so it is a restatement and does not lift the POL-GEN-02(2) cap to 1.0. (iii) The SGD 3.20 driver compensation (derived.money.driver_compensation) is conditional on POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full, which it is not. (iv) The anti-farming check is passed — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below 4) and 1/120 = 0.008 (not above 0.08) — so nothing is withheld on that ground and POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged by it. (v) POL-NS-03 does not take over: it requires a stationary dwell of 300 s within 400 m of the pin, and the 377.4 m figure is a moving approach, not a dwell; registered_pickup_points is 1, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises either. (vi) Escalation under POL-NS-09(b) is declined. That trigger requires that no clause resolve the trip-record/trace conflict, and POL-NS-05 resolves it by testing and falsifying the button-pressed marker; POL-NS-12 is not open (it covers GPS_AUTO arrivals only, and this marker is BUTTON), and POL-NS-09(a), (c) and (e) are not engaged.

6. Weight and confidence. EV-TRIP-00410 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.4 with issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, and both sides disclosed it as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. The tag is schema-level: it meets none of POL-NS-08's limbs (a) to (d) — the 09:10:00 event matches a trace fix to within seconds, the trace has no gap over 120 s and carries 84 fixes, the chat holds exactly the 2 messages the trip record counts, and the $4.00 fare line equals the cancellation fee in force ($4.00, identical to platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd). It is therefore down-weighted under POL-GEN-02 only and does not decide the case: the deciding facts are the driver's position (EV-GPS-00410, weight 1.0) and the fee charged (EV-FARE-00410, weight 1.0), so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and no POL-NS-08 closing-sentence escalation applies. Confidence 0.90.

The monetary effect, $4.00, is below the $8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05), so it executes automatically on issue; both parties may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
referrals: POL-NS-05(ii) — record trip TRP-00410 as a false-arrival event against driver DRV-11417: the 2026-08-24T09:10:00+08:00 button-pressed arrival marker was set while the driver's own GPS trace placed him about 850 m from the pickup pin, and no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip.
